# ShoreBridge BPO

> ShoreBridge BPO is an outsourcing company in Dhaka, Bangladesh, founded by S. M. Ruhul Azim Rifath. We build dedicated offshore teams for companies in the United States and Bangladesh, with US-business-hours coverage at roughly 60% below US labor cost.

## Services

- [Call Center & Customer Support](https://shorebridgebpo.com/services/call-center/): Inbound/outbound voice, chat, and email teams. $6–9 per agent per hour.
- [Graphic Design & Video Editing](https://shorebridgebpo.com/services/creative/): Dedicated designers and video editors; brief in your evening, delivered by your morning. $8–15 per hour.
- [Telemedicine & Healthcare Back-Office](https://shorebridgebpo.com/services/healthcare/): Scheduling, insurance verification, patient intake, telehealth coordination for US clinics. $7–10 per hour.
- [Back-Office, Data & Virtual Assistants](https://shorebridgebpo.com/services/back-office/): Data entry, CRM upkeep, bookkeeping support, research, and VAs. $4–7 per hour.
